description: This file is a PHP template used for rendering error pages, specifically handling unexpected errors by displaying an error code and message within an HTML structure.

methods.name: $this->layout
methods.description: Sets the layout template for the error page, passing the layout name and parameters.

methods.name: $this->section
methods.description: Defines a section ('error-debug') for additional error details or debug info.

methods.name: $this->raw
methods.description: Outputs raw content for the message parameter within the error page.

methods.description: Replaces or ends the current section or template block.
